spectrum_csv_real_imag: raw SI spectrum before 8-10 mHz filter
frequency_filter: unity below 8 mHz; cosine 8-10 mHz; zero at and above 10 mHz
sampling_scope: provided native radial nodes crossed with the complete 2L angular grid; radial completeness is defined by the input file
kernel_angular_grid: GSHTrans GaussLegendreGrid ForBand(lmax,2,2.0), theta-major then longitude
kernel_interface_side_rule: native q=0 maps Side::Above; q=NN-1 maps Side::Below when at a model interface
kernel_memory_estimate_method: 48 bytes per angular point for places and frame geometry, 6-component 8-order strain tables per radial point and degree, 3x the 64-place spin/Legendre workspace, one local tile, and 512 MiB fixed reserve; accumulator and output are disk-backed
kernel_binary_layout: float64 native endian; parameter-major A,C,F,L,N, then radial block, then angle
